turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
I can check whether the address can still be changed. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email used for the order, along with the new delivery address.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
